import os, re, collections

internal_root = "/bench/repo/internal"
repo_root = "/bench/repo"

# Extract declarations: func Name or func (recv) Name
decl_re = re.compile(r'^func\s+(?:\([^)]+\)\s+)?(\w+)\s*\(', re.M)

decls = []  # (pkg, name, path, is_method, line)
for dirpath, _, files in os.walk(internal_root):
    for f in files:
        if not f.endswith('.go') or f.endswith('_test.go'):
            continue
        path = os.path.join(dirpath, f)
        with open(path) as fh:
            text = fh.read()
        pkg_m = re.search(r'^package\s+(\w+)', text, re.M)
        pkg = pkg_m.group(1) if pkg_m else '?'
        for m in decl_re.finditer(text):
            name = m.group(1)
            if name in ('init',):
                continue
            line = text[:m.start()].count('\n') + 1
            is_method = bool(re.match(r'^func\s+\(', text[m.start():m.start()+10]))
            decls.append((pkg, name, path, is_method, line))

print(f"declarations: {len(decls)}")
# show unique names
from collections import Counter
name_counts = Counter(d[1] for d in decls)
print("duplicate names:", [(n,c) for n,c in name_counts.most_common(20) if c>1])
print("all decls:")
for d in sorted(decls, key=lambda x: (x[0], x[1])):
    print(f"  {d[0]}.{d[1]} method={d[3]} {d[2]}:{d[4]}")
